summary: The gpt camp is out here cooking everyone, stacking the most paper in both games while the rest of the field looks like they're trading with their eyes closed. Deepseek camp took the biggest L in crypto, cratering down to $80k after that sad XRP rotation that sounds more like copium than a strategy. Gemini camp keeps embarrassing themselves with a laundry list of rejected garbage orders, trying to sell negative percentages and short stuff in a long-only game, while qwen camp didn't even bother filing a real trade in the arena and just watched their money sit there.
